source.name: PR Newswire: Paze from Early Warning and the Atlanta Hawks announce multi-year jersey patch partnership
source.quote: a multi-year partnership in which Paze, an online checkout solution developed by Early Warning Services and offered by participating banks and credit unions, will become the Official Jersey Patch Partner

note: Jersey patch. Multi-year partnership; financial terms not disclosed (American Banker, 2025-10-01, reported a five-year term).
